Tipos de sitio donde se hace: Types of spot where it is done
Todavía no se fía: Does not trust you for credit yet
Tomas seguidas que provocan sobredosis: Consecutive doses that cause an overdose
Tope de enemigos de más, en tanto por ci: Cap on extra enemies, in percent
Tope de puntería de más, en tanto por ci: Cap on extra aim, in percent
Tope de salud de más, en tanto por cient: Cap on extra health, in percent
Traición por debajo de {get} de lealtad;: Betrayal below {get} loyalty; the bank accepts {get2} euros a day in dirty money
Un arma solo le alcanza si llega hasta a: A weapon only reaches them if it gets that far.
Un barrio se compra por unos {get} euros: A neighborhood is bought for about {get} euros; tribute of about {get2} a day
Un beso o la noche, oliendo mal: A kiss or the night, smelling bad
Un día por línea, en minúsculas y con ti: One day per line, in lowercase and with the accent: lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves, viernes, sábado, domingo.
Un minuto del juego son dos segundos de: One game minute is two clock seconds.
Un nombre por línea. Van de oeste a este: One name per line. They run from west to east.
Un nombre por línea. Van de sur a norte: One name per line. They run from south to north and are 90 meters apart.
A pedestrian can take 50 and the player, 100.
Un regalo a domicilio da este por ciento: A gift delivered to the door gives this percent of the affinity it would give in person
Un tipo de lugar por línea, por ejemplo: One type of place per line, for example cine, or bar, taberna and club. An in-person date comes with you and the plan happens on arriving at one of those places; when you meet up, the game picks one near where that person usually is. Empty, a walk: done on foot, with no fixed place.
Un tipo de lugar por línea: casino, club: One type of place per line: casino, club...
Un tipo de lugar por línea: club, casino: One type of place per line: club, casino...
Una avenida, de sur a norte: An avenue, from south to north
Una calle, de oeste a este: A street, from west to east
Una consecuencia que dura después de la: A lasting consequence after the mission and after the story ends. Negative, if it costs money.
Una decisión del jugador, con consecuenc: A decision by the player, with consequences
Una escena por línea, con {n}. Se cuenta: One scene per line, with {n}. All are counted, in order.
Una frase por línea. Donde pongas {quien: One line per phrase. Where you put {quien}, it will say "A man", "A woman" or their name, if they have already told you.
One phrase per line; it says one at random.
Una frase por línea; dice una al azar. L: One phrase per line; it says one at random. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: [he|she].
Una más si llegan con mucha fuerza, y ot: One more if they arrive with great strength, and another if it is an alliance.
Una noticia hace que la empresa dé un sa: A piece of news makes the company jump, up or down.
Una palabra por línea: atraco (al atraca: One word per line: atraco (when robbing a pedestrian), guantera (when breaking into a car), caido (from the pocket of someone who falls) or buceo (from the seabed). What comes up from diving counts as found; the rest, as stolen.
Una palabra que la identifica, sin espac: A word that identifies it, with no spaces: concejal, traicion. With it, other missions and steps can depend on what was chosen.
Una palabra sin espacios: reloj, portati: A word with no spaces: reloj, portatil.
Una por línea, con su artículo: unas zap: One per line, with its article: a pair of new sneakers.
Una por línea, con {ciudad}. Detrás va l: One per line, with {ciudad}. The explanation follows.
Una por línea, con {d}: los días que que: One per line, with {d}: the days left.
Una por línea, con {euros} y {n}, que di: One per line, with {euros} and {n}, which says how many houses.
Una por línea, con {modelo} y {n}, que d: One per line, with {modelo} and {n}, which says how many are going.
Una por línea, con {nombre}. Lo que camb: One per line, with {nombre}. Anything that changes with the protagonist goes in brackets.
Una por línea, con {n}, {casa} y {antes}: One per line, with {n}, {casa} and {antes}, the house you are leaving.
Una por línea, con {n}. Escríbelas de fo: One per line, with {n}. Write them so they work for both a man and a woman.
Una por línea, con {n}. Se cumple dándol: One per line, with {n}. It is met by giving them at least what "The least that counts if they asked you for money" says.
Una por línea, con {que}: lo que encuent: One per line, with {que}: what they find.
Una por línea, con {total}, {dinero} y {: One per line, with {total}, {dinero} and {falta}, which already include the word euros.
Una por línea, en minúscula y sin el nom: One per line, in lowercase and without the name in front: waves hello. The game puts the character's name in front.
Una por línea, en minúsculas: súper, mer: One per line, in lowercase: súper, mercado, gasolinera. The first type in the list that fits wins.
Una por línea. Al escribir un mensaje a: One per line. When writing a message to the other players, Tab, or a gamepad button, cycles through them and leaves the chosen one typed: so you do not have to type.
Una por línea. Cada vez que se hace el p: One per line. Each time the plan is carried out, two are counted, and they do not repeat until all have been heard. Where you put {n} goes your partner's name. Write them so they work whether your partner is a man or a woman.
Una por línea. Donde pongas {n} irá cuán: One per line. Where you put {n} goes how many there are.
Una por línea. Es lo que dice de vez en: One per line. It is what a character of that kind, among those the server runs, says from time to time to someone nearby. Empty, the ones the server brings.
Una por línea. Es lo que te dice alguien: One per line. It is what someone says to you when you press Enter next to them.
Una por línea. Las dice el lector, con s: One per line. The reader says them, with their name in front. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: Go get [him|her].
Una por línea. Lo que cambie según el pr: One per line. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: proud.
One per line. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: quiet.
Una por línea. Se ofrecen al hablar en p: One per line. They are offered when speaking in character on a server with role-play channels.
Una por línea. {banda} es la banda y {ba: One per line. {banda} is the gang and {barrio}, the neighborhood.
Una por línea. {cosas} es lo que se tira: One per line. {cosas} is what gets thrown out.
Una por línea. {local} es el sitio, {cos: One per line. {local} is the place, {cosas} what you order, {minutos} how long it will take and {casa} your home.
Una por línea. {nombre} es el nombre del: One per line. {nombre} is the protagonist's name.
Una por línea. {n} es cuántos de los tuy: One per line. {n} is how many of your people are going with you.
One per line. {n} is their name.
Una por línea. {quienes} es quién los ma: One per line. {quienes} is who sends them, for example "La Trastienda's people" or "Los Lagartos", and {n}, how many are coming.
Una por línea. {quien} es quien atiende: One per line. {quien} is whoever is serving and {botin}, the money.
Una por línea. {quien} es «Un hombre» o: One per line. {quien} is "A man" or "A woman", and {quien_min}, the same in lowercase. The phrase they say follows.
Una por línea. {total} es lo que suma la: One per line. {total} is what the basket adds up to, already with the word euros.
Una por línea: el identificador, un igua: One per line: the identifier, an equals sign and how it is said. The game understands vender and cocinar.
Una por línea; dice una al azar. {lugar}: One per line; it says one at random. {lugar} is the place and {modelo}, the vehicle.
Una vez al día; el doble si el plato sal: Once a day; double if the dish turns out high-class. Only with adult content and partner life.
Unidades de mercancía que caben en un hu: Units of product that fit in a slot
Unidades que cocina al día alguien en tu: Units that someone in your lab cooks per day, at least
Unidades que vende al día un camello, co: Units that a dealer sells per day, at least
Uno del catálogo de la sección Tipos de: One from the catalog in the Enemy types section: it provides the name, weapon, health, aim, phrases and, if it has one, the vehicle they arrive in. If you choose it, the fields below are only needed to change something of that type in this group. If you leave it empty, write at least the name and the weapon.
Uno por línea, con el nombre interno del: One per line, with the internal name of the conversation base topic: tiempo, futbol, trabajo_duro, dinero, comida... If you leave it empty, the default ones apply.
One per line, with the internal name of the type. When entering any other place, the helicopter stops seeing the player.
One per line, with the internal name of the type: banco, tienda, taller...
One per line, with the internal name of the type: bar, taberna, gimnasio...
One per line, with the internal name of the type: tienda, comida, bar, taberna, ropa, gimnasio... Each place can also require it or remove it on its own.
Uno por línea, con el tipo, un signo igu: One per line, with the type, an equals sign and what it is called: taller=The mechanic. It appears in the robbery phrases.
Uno por línea, con su artículo: el Chato: One per line, with its article: El Chato, La Culebra.
Uno por línea, con su artículo: la testi: One per line, with its article: the witness, the accountant.
Uno por línea, con su artículo: un malet: One per line, with its article: a briefcase with documents.
Uno por línea, con su artículo: una pare: One per line, with its article: a young couple with a baby.
Uno por línea, hasta cuatro: el coche ro: One per line, up to four: the red car, the white van.
Uno por línea. Al ponerle nombre a un ve: One per line. When naming a vehicle, Tab, or a gamepad button, suggests a few at random: so you do not have to type.
Uno por línea. Cada pedido sale de uno,: One per line. Each order comes from one of them, at random.
Uno por línea. El banco y el proveedor t: One per line. The bank and the supplier have their own robbery.
Uno por línea. El juego elige uno al rec: One per line. The game picks one when recruiting the first person; it can be changed afterward.
Uno por línea. Lo que cambie con el prot: One per line. Anything that changes with the protagonist goes in brackets: inspector.
One per line. They are chosen at random.
Uno por línea. Son los de la gente con l: One per line. They are those of the people you talk to on the street.
Uno por línea. Son los personajes que ll: One per line. They are the characters the server runs when someone joins it with this data.
Uno por línea: el identificador, un igua: One per line: the identifier, an equals sign and how it is said. For example, elegante=elegant, or calle=casual. The clothing store groups by these styles, and the clothes, footwear and people use the identifier.
Uno tuyo, comprado o mejorado, se paga e: One of yours, bought or upgraded, is paid in full according to its value and condition; a stolen one, only this share.
Vacío, 1. Con 3 sale tres veces más que: Empty, 1. With 3 it appears three times more than an ordinary one among people their age.
Vacío, cualquiera. La gente de la calle: Empty, anyone. People on the street are between 19 and 74 years old.
Vacío, cualquiera. Por ejemplo 27 para u: Empty, anyone. For example 27 for a student, or 66 for a job people retire from.
Vacío, el paso vale siempre. Si escribes: Empty, the step always applies. If you write the name of a decision, this step is only played when the option you indicate below was chosen.
Vacío, el precio general, que está en la: Empty, the general price, which is in the Fuel section.
Vacío, es ropa corriente. Con un número,: Empty, it is ordinary clothing. With a number, when you put it on, your armor rises up to that value if you had less.
Empty, the one for their enemy type.
Vacío, la de su tipo de enemigo. Un peat: Empty, the one for their enemy type. A pedestrian can take 50 and the player, 100.
Vacío, la misión aparece siempre. Si esc: Empty, the mission always appears. If you write the name of a decision, it only appears when the option you indicate below was chosen. This makes the story branch.
Empty, the ones the stock weapon comes with.
Vacío, lo de serie: 7 el motor, 15 los f: Empty, the defaults: 7 the engine, 15 the brakes, 25 the armor, 25 the tires, 15 the suspension, 30 the exhaust and 30 the tank.
Vacío, si se dice igual: taxista, estudi: Empty, if it is said the same: taxi driver, student.
Vacío, sin tope. Con cero, la misión apa: Empty, no cap. With zero, the mission appears only if none is met.
Vacío, todas. Con un número, basta con q: Empty, all of them. With a number, it is enough for that many to be met.
Vale también para los objetivos de los c: It also applies to the targets of contracts where you only have to scare them.
Valor mínimo de su carácter, de 0 a 100: Minimum value of their character, from 0 to 100
Van a pie aunque su tipo tenga vehículo: They go on foot even if their type has a vehicle
Vehículo siempre aparcado en la puerta: Vehicle always parked at the door
Vehículos de la banda con los que puede: Gang vehicles they can come with
Vehículos del jugador que caben en la ca: Player vehicles that fit on the street
Vehículos que circulan y aparcan: Vehicles that drive around and park
Vehículos que compra cada desguace al dí: Vehicles each scrapyard buys per day
Velocidad de los rivales, en metros por: Rivals' speed, in meters per second
Viene con uno de ellos, al azar, cuando: It comes with one of them, at random, when you do not ask for one from your garage.
Vienen por la calle hacia el jugador, pa: They come down the street toward the player, stop nearby and get out. Empty, whatever their enemy type says, which can be on foot.
Vigilar un lugar un rato sin que te vean: Watch a place for a while without being seen
Vivir en pareja, contenido para adultos: Living together as a couple, adult content
Volumen de la música de fondo de los loc: Volume of the venues' background music, in percent
Volumen de la radio por los auriculares,: Volume of the radio through headphones, on foot, in percent
